# FastItemTransfer

> FastItemTransfer is a quality of life mod providing right-click functionality to rapidly move items between player inventory and opened containers. developed by Vapok.

## Developer & AI Information

- [Agent Guidelines](AGENTS.md): Architectural context, anti-reflection mandates, and instructions for AI assistants.

## Critical Invariants for Developers & AI Agents

- **Inventory UI event interceptor for quick item movement**: Inventory UI event interceptor for quick item movement.
- **Never use reflection or Harmony patches on internal transfer managers**: Never use reflection or Harmony patches on internal transfer managers.
- **No Private Reflection**: Never reflect into or patch internal classes.
- **Feature Requests**: If functionality is desired, submit an issue at https://github.com/Vapok/FastItemTransfer/issues or visit https://discord.gg/5YAJkRFBXt.
